name: Agently
description: AI Chief of Staff that holds your whole company context with persistent memory across 100+ tool connectors. Links Stripe events to Slack threads to Linear tickets automatically, routes work to specialized agents, and executes end-to-end workflows with temporal knowledge graph that understands state changes.
community_quotes: The underrated part is the compounding. Most AI tools are identical on day 1 and day 100. If the brain genuinely gets sharper the more it ingests and the more you correct it, that's a real moat
The persistent context across tools - not just another AI assistant answering prompts, but a system that can connect events and move work forward automatically
Honestly the linking between Stripe, Slack, and Linear without me setting anything up kind of freaked me out in a good way

name: AgentKey
description: One-stop live data marketplace plugin that connects AI agents to live external data (business, crypto, web, social) in one command. Ranked #1 Product of the Day on Product Hunt July 13, 2026 with 691 upvotes.

name: Osaurus
description: Open-source AI agent platform that runs 100% locally on Mac with no account or subscription needed. Native Swift app (not Electron) that provides persistent memory and autonomous agent capabilities for calendar, contacts, and messaging.

name: Second Brain for AI v2
description: AI memory system that connects information across every tool in a developer's workflow, providing persistent memory and knowledge retrieval across sessions.

name: FetchSandbox
description: API integration testing tool with memory capabilities that remembers what breaks in the testing process.

name: Aura
description: Git-native semantic version control IDE for AI coding agents. Tracks code changes at the AST level rather than text, allowing surgical rewinds of broken functions, blocking undocumented AI commits, and orchestrating massive code generation while saving 95% on LLM tokens. 100% local, Apache 2.0 open-source.
community_quotes: This is a really interesting direction — moving from text diffs to intent + AST-level tracking makes a lot of sense in an AI-first workflow
The aura rewind for single functions is exactly what I need — reverting entire PRs because one AI-generated function broke things has been my biggest pain point with Claude Code
The 93% token reduction on handover is wild if that holds up in practice

name: Tabstack
description: Browser automation tool for AI agents that reads accessibility trees instead of using screenshots, reducing token costs by 60-80%. Agents can automate web tasks like booking meetings or filling forms.

name: Auriko
description: Trading desk API for LLM calls, allowing developers to optimize and manage API calls to large language models.

name: agents-cli
description: CLI tool specifically designed for AI coding agents to ship themselves from idea/demo to production. Provides scaffolding, evaluation, and deployment features tailored for AI agents like Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Cursor.

name: NanoKVM-Go
description: Hardware/software solution that gives AI agents physical control over any screen, extending agent capabilities beyond the terminal.

name: TryCase
description: Disposable test environments specifically designed for AI coding agents. Provides isolated sandbox environments for testing AI-generated code.

name: Tamamon
description: Desktop companion pet that grows as you code with Claude Code, gamifying the coding experience.
